exercises.title: Future Forms — Verifica argomento
exercises.description: Verifica autonoma sulla scelta tra will, be going to e Present Continuous for future in base al significato del contesto.
exercises.instructions: Non scegliere dalla presenza di tomorrow: identifica decisione, previsione, piano o arrangement.

sections.title: Verifica argomento
sections.instructions: Leggi il contesto completo e scegli la forma futura che esprime quel significato.

questions.title: Item 1
questions.prompt: The phone is ringing. — Don't worry, I ___ it.
questions.learning_objective: Choose will for a decision made at the moment of speaking.

options.text: will answer
am going to answer every day
will to answer

feedback.explanation: The decision is made now: I'll answer it.

questions.title: Item 2
questions.prompt: Marta has decided to study medicine next year. She ___ medicine at university.
questions.instructions: Choose the form that expresses her prior plan.
questions.learning_objective: Choose be going to for a plan or intention decided before speaking.

options.text: is going to study
will study because she decided just now
going to study

feedback.explanation: The plan already exists: is going to study.

questions.title: Item 3
questions.prompt: We've booked a table for 8:00. We ___ Anna and Luca at the restaurant tonight.
questions.instructions: Choose the form that best expresses the organised arrangement.
questions.learning_objective: Choose Present Continuous for a future arrangement with concrete organisation.

options.text: are meeting
will meet because the phone just rang
meeting

feedback.explanation: A booked time and place make this an arrangement: are meeting.

questions.title: Item 4
questions.prompt: Look at those black clouds. It ___ rain.
questions.instructions: Choose the prediction based on present evidence.
questions.learning_objective: Choose be going to for a prediction based on visible evidence.

options.text: is going to
will to
is rain

feedback.explanation: Visible clouds are present evidence: is going to rain.

questions.title: Item 5
questions.learning_objective: Build will + base verb and be going to + base verb accurately.

content.text_template: I think our team [[blank_1]] win. Sara [[blank_2]] apply for the course; she decided last week.

feedback.explanation: Opinion prediction: will win. Prior decision: is going to apply.

questions.title: Item 6
questions.prompt: Select all sentences whose future form fits the context.
questions.instructions: There may be more than one correct answer.
questions.learning_objective: Evaluate future-form choice and grammatical form together.

options.text: I think prices will rise next year.
We're meeting the tutor at 4:30; it's in my calendar.
Watch out! You're going to drop that glass.
I've decided: I will to call them tomorrow.
She going to start a new course next month.

feedback.explanation: Meaning and complete form must both fit: will, be going to or an arranged Present Continuous.

questions.title: Item 7
questions.learning_objective: Distinguish an immediate decision from a previously arranged plan in dialogue.

options.text: I'll go and get some.
I'm meeting the bread at the shop.
I will to go and get some.

feedback.explanation: Leo decides at that moment: I'll go.

questions.title: Item 8
questions.instructions: Use the future form that matches each context.
questions.learning_objective: Switch between arrangement, prior plan and opinion prediction in connected context.

content.text_template: On Saturday I [[blank_1]] (meet) Sara at the station at 9:15; the tickets are booked. After that we [[blank_2]] (visit) the science museum because we decided yesterday. I think the weather [[blank_3]] (be) good, so we may walk back.

feedback.explanation: Booked arrangement → am meeting; prior plan → are going to visit; opinion prediction → will be.

questions.title: Item 9
questions.prompt: Correct both mistakes: I'm going buy a new laptop. I will to order it tonight.
questions.instructions: Rewrite both sentences with complete future structures.
questions.learning_objective: Correct missing to/be going to structure and to after will.

accepted_answers: I'm going to buy a new laptop. I will order it tonight.
I am going to buy a new laptop. I will order it tonight.

feedback.explanation: Be going to + base; will + base without to.

questions.title: Item 10
questions.prompt: Ho già deciso: il mese prossimo inizierò un corso di fotografia. Martedì incontro l'insegnante alle cinque; è già fissato. Guarda quelle nuvole: secondo me sta per piovere. — Allora prenderò io l'ombrello.
questions.instructions: Translate the full context into English.
questions.learning_objective: Produce prior plan, arrangement, evidence prediction and immediate decision in one connected context.

accepted_answers: I've already decided: next month I'm going to start a photography course. I'm meeting the teacher on Tuesday at five; it's already arranged. Look at those clouds: I think it's going to rain. — Then I'll take the umbrella.

I have already decided: next month I am going to start a photography course. I am meeting the teacher on Tuesday at five; it is already arranged. Look at those clouds: I think it is going to rain. — Then I will take the umbrella.

feedback.explanation: Prior plan → going to; fixed arrangement → Present Continuous; evidence → going to; immediate decision → will.
